description: Mohamed Hassaan Mohamed Hydher at Graz University of Technology publishes the LAPO dataset for an EWSN 2026 study of language-model-assisted parameter optimisation in low-power wireless networks. It contains tested parameter sets, measured outcomes, proposed settings and recorded rationales for the Crystal and RPL protocols under four application requirements. The metadata also identifies live runs on the D-Cube testbed, prompts, example protocol summaries and recorded testbed traces replayed by an emulator. Those traces originate from the APEX dataset. Four public ZIP archives and a README are listed. Internal formats remain unknown because the README was not inspected. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. The dataset supports reproducing wireless-protocol optimisation and evaluating emulator-based network experiments. Its coverage is the documented testbed and experiment configurations, with no national deployment coverage or sampling interval established. The source links the associated conference paper by DOI; no directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
